caption: A custom cushion cut solitaire in 14k gold.  I’d love to do a chunky version of this style asap!!!!

Rooted in tradition with a modern flair, @sowsong__ is a custom jewellery brand founded in 2025 by Vancouver Island local Tia Noelle. Inspired by romance, history, and the poetry of keepsakes, each piece is thoughtfully handcrafted to hold meaning and memory.

After years as a florist, Tia was drawn to the timelessness of jewellery and apprenticed with local mentors to master the art of metalsmithing. Today, she works from a converted Travelux trailer studio—an intimate, soulful space that reflects her Western roots and honours her late grandfather, the inspiration behind the name “Sow Song.”

Specializing in custom designs, Tia begins every piece with a conversation. From heirloom gold reimagined into something new, to memorial pendants and engagement rings, connection is at the heart of her work. She primarily uses sterling silver and solid gold and carefully sources stones from small-scale suppliers, with a long-term vision of working exclusively with antique diamonds.

Guided by sustainability and intention, Sow Song is built on quality over quantity. These are pieces meant to be lived in, loved daily, and passed down—future heirlooms that connect people to each other and the stories they carry. ✨

Read more about Tia and the philosophy behind her craft in our Meet the Maker series from @confluence.nimmobay, link in bio.

📷 @gnarstie and @__christiefitzpatrick
